highlights.excerpt: Every child in America will receive two SpaceX shares, one from the company and one from me personally

highlights.name: Elon Musk

highlights.excerpt: I asked Claude to populate a Civilization-style game map with real data from the US. Opus 5.5 downloaded and parse a ton of public data and 7 hours and 45K lines of code later... it works :)
highlights.excerpt_zh: 我让 Claude 用美国真实数据填充一张文明风格的游戏地图。Opus 5.5 下载并解析了大量公开数据，7 小时、4.5 万行代码之后……它能跑了 :)
highlights.name: Andrej Karpathy
highlights.text_zh: 用 Opus 5.5 花 7 小时写出 4.5 万行代码，把美国真实数据做成文明风格地图。

highlights.excerpt:
We made a billing mistake at launch of GPT-6.2 that incorrectly discounted GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol usage for most users. 

We’ve fixed this now, so the same work will use more of your plan’s usage allowance. Comparing to last week, you will reach your limits 40% faster on GPT-6.2
highlights.excerpt_zh:
我们在 GPT-6.2 发布时出现了计费错误，导致大多数用户的 GPT-6.2 Astra 和 Sol 用量被错误地打折。

现已修复，因此同样的工作会占用你套餐里更多的用量额度。与上周相比，你用 GPT-6.2 会快 40% 达到上限。
highlights.name: Tibo
highlights.text_zh: 称 GPT-6.2 发布时计费出错，修复后同样工作会快 40% 用完额度。

highlights.excerpt: Ven was one of the earliest believers that we could use our then-current model to solve millenium prize problems.
highlights.excerpt_zh: Ven 是最早相信我们可以用当时的模型去攻克千禧年大奖难题的人之一。
highlights.name: Sam Altman
highlights.text_zh: 感谢 Ven 很早相信可用当时的模型冲击千禧年大奖难题。

highlights.excerpt: Gemini 4 Neon built this interactive 3D oven planner to solve Thanksgiving's toughest oven jigsaw logistics problem. Dial in your turkey weight, sides, and serving time to map out rack space, resolve temp conflicts, and generate a printable minute-by-minute checklist.
highlights.excerpt_zh: Gemini 4 Neon 做了这个交互式 3D 烤箱规划器，用来解决感恩节最难的烤箱「拼图」排布问题。输入火鸡重量、配菜和开饭时间，就能规划烤架空间、解决温度冲突，并生成可打印的逐分钟清单。
highlights.name: Google Gemini
highlights.text_zh: Gemini 4 Neon 做了感恩节烤箱 3D 排布工具，可生成分时清单。

highlights.excerpt:
A guy let Claude read his 1994 Jeep's engine computer through a $3 chip.

It found why the car kept failing smog, and he says it passed. 

The whole thing cost about $15 in parts, and it's free on GitHub. https://t.co/E9kOFaX8sq
highlights.excerpt_zh:
有人用一枚 3 美元的芯片，让 Claude 读取他那辆 1994 年吉普的发动机电脑。

它找出了这车总过不了排放检测的原因，他说后来通过了。

全部零件大约 15 美元，而且在 GitHub 上免费。 https://t.co/E9kOFaX8sq
highlights.name: GREG ISENBERG
highlights.text_zh: 有人用 3 美元芯片让 Claude 读 1994 年吉普发动机电脑，通过了排放检测。

highlights.excerpt: Neon has doubled day over day usage on Perplexity (no default model routing), doing 100B+ tokens in a single day. It’s rare to see such an exponential growth for a model. We’ve merged in some harness improvements to address formatting issues that existed earlier.
highlights.excerpt_zh: Neon 在 Perplexity 上的日用量翻倍（没有默认模型路由），单日 token 超过 1000 亿。这种指数级增长对一个模型来说很少见。我们已经合并了一些工具层改进，以解决早先存在的格式问题。
highlights.name: Aravind Srinivas
highlights.text_zh: 称 Neon 在 Perplexity 日用量翻倍，单日 token 超过 1000 亿。
